Name: Jeuel
Summary: Son of Zerah dwelling in Jerusalem, with his brethren six hundred and ninety.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:6: Son of Zerah dwelling in Jerusalem, with his brethren six hundred and ninety.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeuel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
